correctness.rationale: For every b>=2 and h>=1, root-fixed level/arc-preserving endomorphisms have idempotent image exactly a nonempty leaf-selected prefix closure. The fixed-point child-propagation argument proves necessity; choosing a retained child and a compatible subtree map proves sufficiency. Every labelled image Y has A_d(Y)=(sum_j A_(d-1)(Y_j))^b and R_d(Y)=(prod_j R_(d-1)(Y_j))*(sum_j A_(d-1)(Y_j))^(b-k). Induction on retained root children gives all integer image ranks h+1 through N=1+...+b^h; the adjacent k-rank intervals touch since N_(h-1)>=2h-1. Direct argument verifies coefficients b^h, b^(h-1)*C(b,2)*2^(b^h-2), b^h(b-1), 1 at the boundary exponents (with overlapping exponents interpreted consistently). Fresh independently implemented composition enumeration tested all 547,920 maps in the five cases (b,h)=(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,2), reproducing all image-rank histograms and total retraction counts 3,21,1065,10,9028. Finite enumerations corroborate, while the inductive proof establishes arbitrary parameters.
